thread:
nina: Idea  "Postcards & Pick-Me-Up" micro-activation next Tue 3/21 11:30-1:00 in the mezzanine. Handwritten recognition postcards + a small snack cart (granola bars, fruit cups). Keep it low-cost and high-touch. Volunteers to help write postcards?

people-ops: Love it. Micro-event budget is $500. We need an itemized estimate (printing, snacks, cart fee), an event owner for receipts, and a plan to track any awarded gift value.

devrel: I can help run the postcard table 11:30-12:15. Happy to bring stamps and pens.

leo: I can print 120 postcards for ~$28 and bring a cute stamp pad. I'll prep a short message template.

people-ops-bot: /reminder set "Confirm snack cart booking" for @nina tomorrow 09:00

nina: draft estimate: postcards $28, snack cart vendor "NoshNook" (2-hr setup) $220, snack supplies $35, stamps $30. Total ~$313.

payroll: Quick note from payroll: small non-cash items under de minimis thresholds usually aren't taxable, but we must track recipients and values. If we hand out vouchers or cash-equivalents >$100 to an individual, it will need reporting. For this concept, tracking names/emails on the postcard log should suffice.

people-ops: Good. We'll include a short transparency blurb in the invite: "Postcards & snacks are a token of recognition; per policy we track recipients and report per payroll rules."

facilities: Mezzanine booking is available. Need a calendar invite and a quick site map for where the cart can park. Also confirm power not required.

devrel: I'll create a tiny Google RSVP + nomination form and add a checkbox if people want their postcard hand-signed or anonymous.

leo: postcard template (front/back):
```
Front: "Thanks for making our week better!" + line for short note (1-2 sentences)
Back: "From: __________________\nTeam: __________________\nEmail (optional): __________________"
```

nina: Do we want to attach a $10 snack voucher to a subset (surprise spot-awards) or keep snacks free-all?

people-ops: Options: a) keep snacks freely available to everyone (simplest); b) attach $10 voucher to 25 surprise postcards (track recipients for payroll). If we go with vouchers we must log recipients and value. Recommend free snacks + 25 surprise spot postcards with a sticker denoting "Spot Award $10" so we have a record.

devrel: I like that. Makes it celebratory but keeps bookkeeping light. I'll handle the sticker printing.

people-ops-bot: spot-awards-bot: Tip: during the event use `/spot-award @person <reason>` to log winners; this auto-populates the award report.

people-ops: Action items:
- nina: submit vendor quote to #expenses and be event owner for receipts.
- leo: print postcards and bring stamp pad + template.
- devrel: build RSVP/nomination form and staff 11:30-12:15.
- facilities: add mezzanine booking to the invite and confirm parking spot for cart.
- people-ops/payroll: we'll publish the 2-line tax blurb once payroll finalizes wording.

nina: I'll submit the estimate today and post the invite once payroll confirms the blurb. Thanks all! :sparkles:

people-ops: Thanks everyone  this feels aligned with our recognition goals. Will post final invite and a quick expense checklist before EOD Monday.
